text_block_list.text: "Lady Fine Motion is crazy for ramen♪ A 'fine' time with school friends ahead of the Shuka Sho."
One day, while riding the train... I spotted a familiar name on a hanging weekly magazine ad...!
I hurriedly told Fine Motion about the advertisement, and—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that really true!?
Wah, it feels like a dream~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I think train advertisements have quite artistic designs, you know!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Having my name listed there
makes me feel like I'm part of the work♪

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
In addition, we are already aware of the article in question
and are currently discussing our response.
However, most likely...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It will likely stay just as it is, per His Highness's wishes. ...Right?
choice_data_list: You sure you don't want me to lower it for you?
Are you sure you don't want me to lower it for you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As for this time, it's not an article that tarnishes
our family's dignity, so I think it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this is merely my personal thought, but...
It makes me happy when people enjoy my presence.
I believe it is close to my very reason for being.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I just feel bad having you worry about every little thing like this, too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say you're welcome to drop in out of nowhere
like during the summer camp, though♪

"Raison d'être"—when she speaks of herself,
she sometimes sounds remarkably detached and objective.
Is that due to her upbringing, or her innate brilliance...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Um, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett-chan!
Good day to you♪

The one who called out was Daiwa Scarlet.
She is a friend of Fine Motion, and I've heard she's an exceptionally talented runner.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, this is a bit awkward to bring up, but... there's something I need to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you talking about the train advertisement?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, you already knew that!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. For now, it looks like I'll just wait and see.
Thanks for checking in on me, though♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No... but seriously, getting an article
written about you just over ramen...
is completely unbearable, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You think so? She even recommended a ramen place
I'd like, which was really sweet of her♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the compensation a bit low!?
Besides, if you're writing an article about Fine-san,
there are so many other things you should focus on!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oho, and what kind of article
would you write for us, Scarlet-chan?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? T-That's...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...The graceful, beautiful running she showed in the Oka Sho and the Yushun Himba (Oaks)! And her dazzling, gorgeous performance during the Winning Live!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, Fine-san's races are simply magnificent! If it were up to me, that's definitely what I'd write about!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh stop, you're making me blush with all that praise~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I hope the two of us can be featured in an article someday.
About our races, of course!

Fine Motion certainly seems to have
many wonderful "schoolmates."
Even after leaving the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
F... Fine-san!
Do you have a moment to talk right now...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-chan.
Yeah, I'm alright!

She is Zenno Rob Roy.
A quiet, book-loving member of the library committee.
She's an Umamusume with high expectations riding on her as well.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, well... I'd like to ask for your opinion on book selection.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Actually... recently, more and more girls have been looking up to Fine-san
and wanting to learn about Irish culture.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
That's wonderful news!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's why I also wanted to provide books that are easy to understand and learn from, even for people who don't usually read.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I picked out a few books,
but I can't decide which ones to stock...
Could you give me some advice...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'd be happy to help!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm heading out.
I'll be back in time for training!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way! That novel Rob Roy-chan
recommended was really good~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! I-I read that poetry collection
you recommended too, Fine-san.
It was truly wonderful...!

There is something mysterious about Fine Motion's strength.
It's not just that she's highly capable; she has something that draws other Umamusume in.
The Shuka Sho—there's no doubt she will show us a whole new side of her charm there as well.
